title: Same Model, Different People: Numerical Execution Contracts and the Reproducibility of Fairness Audits
abstract: arXiv:2611.23657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fairness audits treat a trained model as a fixed decision function, but the arithmetic that evaluates it is part of that function. This study holds the model, records, threshold and audit code fixed and varies the numerical execution contract in two tiers. Tier 1 changes only how products and sums are computed, with the serialized weights byte-identical, and is the causal test of arithmetic. Tier 2 runs reduced-precision deployment configurations (BF16 compute, FP8 and 8-bit weights), which can also round weights and change engines and kernels, so its effects belong to the configuration. It audits three tabular model families and two open-weight language models (4B and 24B parameters) on four public tasks, including hospital readmission, on CPUs and GPUs from NVIDIA, AMD and Apple. translated_title: 同一模型，不同人群：数值执行契约与公平性审计的可复现性
translated_abstract: 公平性审计通常将训练好的模型视为一个固定的决策函数，但用于评估该模型的算术运算本身也是这个函数的一部分。本研究在保持模型、数据记录、阈值和审计代码完全不变的前提下，分两个层级改变数值执行契约。第一层级仅改变乘积与求和的计算方式，序列化权重字节级完全一致，是对算术运算影响的因果测试。第二层级运行降低精度的部署配置（BF16 计算、FP8 及 8 位权重），这些配置还会对权重进行舍入并改变引擎与内核，因此其影响归属于配置层面。研究在四个公开任务（包括住院再入院预测）上，对三个表格模型家族和两个开源权重语言模型（4B 和 24B 参数）进行了审计，硬件覆盖 NVIDIA、AMD 和 Apple 的 CPU 与 GPU。结果显示：第一层级改变了阈值附近的个体决策，而具体改变哪些决策取决于 GPU 及其软件栈，但在预先设定的、未加权的总体指标下（摘要此处被截断）……
tldr: 研究通过因果对照实验证明，即使模型权重与审计代码完全一致，仅仅改变数值计算方式（浮点精度、硬件与软件栈）就会改变阈值附近的个体决策，从而威胁公平性审计结论的跨平台可复现性。
en_tdlr: Through causal experiments with byte-identical model weights and audit code, this study shows that merely changing how arithmetic is executed (precision, hardware, and software stack) alters near-threshold decisions and undermines the cross-platform reproducibility of fairness audit conclusions.
